description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] based on entry element damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Jecht] to the user, grants [Physical Quick Cast 3]/[Physical Quick Cast] to party with at least 0-3/4 X members

description.name: Zenith Mode: Jecht
description.text: Increases [Fire/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Jecht after using two Fire or Dark abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Jecht Beam+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, followed by one ranged attack (1.20/1.25) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses with additional 20% critical damage

description.name: Jecht Shot Mark III+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.10 each), grants [Sharpshooter Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action

description.name: Physical Quick Cast 3
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for PHY attacks

description.name: Physical Quick Cast
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for PHY attacks
